headline: Co-op, editing and rendering improve on the development line
summary: Players gain working Drone Device spawns on PAL and NTSC-U, corrected Novalis sparks and optional settings for fresher controller input and lower frame latency. Creators get a guided level-editor panel, reset controls and packaged parameter layouts that preserve their edits. Enhanced water, chrome and glass gain baked environment reflections, while co-op menus no longer empty another player's world.
highlights: #104 lands custom PAL destinations and cross-level static imports from #101; NTSC-U destination support and manual gameplay validation remain incomplete.
#103 adds persistent savestate support for the same game build and disc; slot files and save/load policy belong to the external Project Save Clank mod.
SDK 1.10.0 and 1.10.1 were published; 1.10.1 adds Android native-mod builds. #111 makes the Development channel follow develop.
#121 restores NTSC-U save-overwrite answers; #124 and #126 fix Exit menu behaviour and preserve the player's language after Quit Game.
#114 guards unusable cameras after a reported NTSC-U 0.9.0 ship-travel black screen; the original fault could not be reproduced.

#119 accounts for 19,210 of the day's 38,239 added lines and adds environment reflections and target-relative motion blur. #123's mod-update and save-mark features were opened, without a merge event today.
